Week 12, July 21, 2026 in Ocala

Week 12-- Winners of the Donut

This was an eventful week! We got to go to the temple again today, so that's why I'm emailing on Tuesday again.

Thursday, 07/16 We had Zone Conference! We talked about inspired questions and how to teach on first contact.

Friday, 07/17 We went to girls camp! The Gainesville stake came down to around our area and we got to join in for about an hour! It was at this really pretty campground right next to a lake (which we weren't allowed to go in, but I got some pretty good pictures of it).

We also had a really fun member meal!

Saturday, 07/18 We started off the day with the 5k, as usual. The member that leads it made an AI song about our weekly runs (the chorus of the song is where the title of this email comes in-- there's always donuts at the end).

We had a church tour with our friend Javon. It went really well! He loved hearing about what our church services are like and he said he'd come the soonest Sunday he's available!

Sunday, 07/19 All of Joel's family came to church again! Arthur and Jeremiah were able to make it as well

Monday, 07/20 We had exchanges! I stayed in Ocala with Sister Canning. We had a member meal and a great lesson with our friend that some Sisters in Georgia gave us! His name is Robert, but he prefers to go by Shorty (I wonder what his relative height is. Is it, perhaps, short? 🤔).

Tuesday, 07/21 We unexchanged at 6:30am. We woke up at 5:45 to start driving away at 6. As soon as we got back to the apartment, we picked up the other Sisters and headed to Talahasee.

We went to the temple! It is so peaceful there and I'm so glad we were able to go. I drove the 2.5 hours there, then I got to relax in the back seat the rest of the time

Spiritual thought Moroni 7:41 And what is it that ye shall hope for? Behold I say unto you that ye shall have hope through the atonement of Christ and the power of his resurrection, to be raised unto life eternal, and this because of your faith in him according to the promise.

I know that you can always trust Jesus Christ to follow through on His promises. This means that He will comfort you in your times of need, and that He'll be there when you reach out.

Type at you later, Sister Christison
